title: OpenAI gpt-4.5-preview model removal
description: OpenAI documents that gpt-4.5-preview was deprecated and removed from the API on 2025-07-14, with gpt-4.1 as the recommended replacement.
oldBehavior: The application sends requests using the retired gpt-4.5-preview model identifier.
newBehavior: The application sends requests using the documented gpt-4.1 replacement model identifier.
migrationInstructions: Replace a direct literal model property set to gpt-4.5-preview with gpt-4.1 and review the resulting behavior.
Keep dynamic model configuration and non-TypeScript/JavaScript usage under human review.

evidenceSources.summary: Official OpenAI deprecation evidence identifies gpt-4.5-preview as removed and gpt-4.1 as the recommended replacement.

review.notes: Reviewed against the official OpenAI deprecations source. The executable transformation is limited to a direct literal model property; dynamic configuration remains review-only.

assumptions: The official source establishes provider/model applicability but does not establish an SDK package or SDK version range.
A direct literal model property is safe to propose for deterministic replacement; dynamic values require human review.
A generated patch remains subject to verification and human approval.
